headline: Grand Oak Canyons Distillery Company Secretary Sarvagya Goel resigns
hook: Company secretary steps down ahead of October
summary: Sarvagya Goel has resigned from his position as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer at Grand Oak Canyons Distillery, with the resignation taking effect on October 17. The company announced the departure in a regulatory filing. For Indian retail investors, leadership changes in corporate secretarial roles are routine administrative updates that rarely impact stock price or operational performance unless accompanied by broader governance shifts.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance exit with no bearing on stock value.
